title: The starting point is a random dynamical system with an attractor

statements.text: The principle starts from a random dynamical system, written as a stochastic differential equation (a flow plus random fluctuations), that has a pullback attractor: a set of characteristic states it returns to from any initial state.

sources.quote: We start by describing the world with a stochastic differential equation
Technically, this means the system has a pullback attractor; namely, a set of states a system will come to occupy from any initial state
